text:
Samir Gupta: quick thought — instead of manually pinging for postmortems after every page, what if we pilot a lightweight scheduler bot in #eng-oncall that proposes 3 slots within 48h of incident close and auto-creates calendar invites with a short agenda? :thinking:
Elaine Park: +1. We've lost momentum waiting on scheduling. can it also attach the incident timeline and top-3 action candidates?
Jordan Lee: would love it to pre-populate the action board ticket draft too. reduces friction for engineers.
Mike R.: critical: needs opt-out if customer impact require longer convo. also timezone handling for APAC folks.
Samir Gupta: totally. basic feature list I had in mind:
- detect incident "resolved" signal (from incbot or handoff)
- propose 3 slots relative to resolver's timezone
- create calendar invite + short agenda + link to incident doc
- draft action items on ActionBoard w/ assignees suggested
- follow-up reminder if no PM scheduled in 72h
Rebecca Chen: tagging @Postmortem-Bot — can we wire the scheduler to use the existing postmortem template and attach eval/metrics?
Postmortem-Bot: yes — can export template sections and prefill Summary, Impact, Timeline, Root Cause, Action Items. will need a service account with calendar + ActionBoard scope.
Jordan Lee: any ideas for UX? I'd prefer one-click accept in slack for proposed slots, and a "reschedule" quick action.
Elaine Park: propose a tiny config YAML for thresholds and default window. e.g.
```
postmortem_scheduler:
  window_hours: 48
  propose_slots: 3
  reminder_hours: 72
  auto_draft_actions: true
  timezone_policy: resolver_local
```
Samir Gupta: nice. ops concerns: who can trigger auto-scheduling? only the incident lead or any approver? recommend lead-only with manual override.
Mike R.: ops +1. Also add data retention note — drafts should be ephemeral until invite accepted.
Rebecca Chen: can we also store suggested assignees from oncall rotation history so action draft isn't empty?
Samir Gupta: yep — draft includes 1) suggested assignees 2) severity-based priority 3) expected owner opt-in.
Jordan Lee: pairing this with the Action Dashboard would let us auto-populate the "Open Remediations" widget. big win for follow-through.
Elaine Park: next steps: mock the slack modal and YAML config, prototype Postmortem-Bot calendar flow, sanity-check permissions with security.
Samir Gupta: I'll spin up a quick spike this week. tagging @Rebecca and @Mike to help with ActionBoard + infra perms. I'll post a follow-up PR with the modal screenshots.
Mike R.: can help with infra. Rebecca — can you check ActionBoard API quotas?
Rebecca Chen: will check and post results here by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan Lee: thanks — excited to try this. :rocket:
